== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The Redflower family is a prominent group within The Empire{{!}}the Empire responsible for large-[[scale]] agricultural production and irrigation. Their various [[Paths]] allow them to grow food and manage rainfall, even in regions where farming is typically impossible. They maintain a significant presence in the flying city of [[Stormrock]], which serves as their family headquarters during emergencies. The family is identified by a red blossom symbol, which can be seen on their wagons and on the chests of its members. Due to their essential role in providing sustenance for The Empire{{!}}the Empire, they receive protection from the [[Skysworn]]; for instance, [[Jai clan]] warriors have been known to escort them during conflicts. Within the family, members such as [[Underlady]] [[Li Min Redflower]] hold positions of Authority{{!}}authority in high-level meetings. Their specialized [[Path of Jade Eyes]] is noted for being unparalleled in the field of healing.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The Redflower family is identified by their symbol of a red blossom and the crimson flowers displayed on the Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns worn upon their chests. Tasked with pulling mobile gardens, the family utilizes a burning wagon for their travels. Despite being subject to the Authority{{!}}authority of the Lowgold{{!}}Lowgolds, who stood over them, the family eventually managed to escape.}}
